programme.desc: Die Truppe von Hansa Rostock um Marco Schuster hofft, ihre Negativserie zu durchbrechen. In den letzten vier Direktbegegnungen spielte die Mannschaft zweimal unentschieden und verlor zweimal. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Auf'm Trecker
programme.desc:
Ein Hof mit Geschichte: Seit 17 Generationen bewirtschaftet Familie Schuhmacher ihren Hof bei Springe, unweit von Hannover. Jetzt steht der Generationswechsel an: Die junge Landwirtin Charlotte übernimmt den Ackerbaubetrieb ihrer Eltern. Zwischen Büro, Hof und Feld wächst sie Schritt für Schritt in ihre neue Rolle hinein.

Mit der Aroniabeere hat Charlotte vor einigen Jahren eine neue Kultur auf den Hof gebracht. Die ursprünglich aus Nordamerika stammende Beere gilt als extrem gesund und ist Charlottes ganzer Stolz.

Die Aronia: Charlottes erstes eigenes Projekt

In diesem Jahr hängen die Büsche so voll wie nie – gute Nachrichten, aber auch eine logistische Herausforderung. Im Schneckentempo und hoch konzentriert müssen sie darauf achten, mit der Erntemaschine gut durchzukommen und keine großen Verluste einzufahren.

Zwischen Drillmaschine und Rübenberg

Vater Götz ist trotz seiner Multiple-Sklerose-Erkrankung fast immer mit auf dem Acker. Meist fährt er die Maschinen, Charlotte übernimmt die körperliche Arbeit – ein Job, der ihr einiges abverlangt. Umso mehr genießt sie die Stunden auf dem Trecker: „Da kann ich den Kopf gut abschalten.“

Nicht aber beim Dinkeldrillen, da zählen Präzision und Konzentration, damit das Saatgut Reihe für Reihe richtig liegt. Und auch die Rübenernte ist jedes Jahr ein Highlight. Wenn die Rodergemeinschaft die großen Mieten auftürmt, sieht man endlich, was man geschafft hat. Und wenn der Zuckergehalt stimmt, ist das umso besser.

Neue Wege auf alten Böden

Neben der Hofübernahme gibt es auch den technischen Wechsel. Der alte Fuhrpark des Hofes muss erneuert werden. Die ersten Versuche mit einer neuen Maschine stehen an: Charlotte hat mit der Anschaffung eines Striegels ihre erste große Investition getätigt – für mehr mechanische und weniger chemische Unkrautbekämpfung. Doch reicht die neue Technik? Oder muss am Ende doch noch gespritzt werden?

Für Charlotte steht fest: Die Landwirtschaft braucht Innovation und Experimentierfreude. Und auch sie selbst hat noch viel vor: „Ich habe noch ein paar Ideen, mal schauen, was sich dann umsetzen lässt.“ So viel verrät sie schon: Vielleicht wird im nächsten Jahr die erste Sojabohne bei Familie Schuhmacher geerntet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Unterwegs auf der Luftlinie
programme.sub-title: In Schleswig-Holstein von Kalifornien nach Reinbek
programme.desc:
Bereits zum neunten Mal sind die erfahrenen Wanderreporter Vanessa Kossen und Thilo Tautz zu Fuß unterwegs auf einer 100 Kilometer langen Luftlinie – diesmal quer durch Schleswig-Holstein.

Konsequent eine Luftlinie zu laufen, ohne Geld und Zelt, immer schnurstracks geradeaus – wie soll das funktionieren? Thilo Tautz startet am Schloss in Reinbek, Vanessa Kossen am Strand von Kalifornien in Schönberg. Ihr Ziel: ein Fußballplatz in Klein Rönnau, der in der Mitte ihrer Luftlinie liegt. Doch sie haben nur drei Tage Zeit, ihn zu erreichen.

Finden Vanessa und Thilo Mitfahrgelegenheiten oder müssen sie die komplette Strecke wirklich zu Fuß zurücklegen? Ein kleines Stück des Weges auf dem Pferderücken zurückzulegen, schont Füße und Rücken, weiß Thilo. Wenn der Magen knurrt, hilft nur eine Charmeoffensive, meint Vanessa.

Geschlafen wird da, wo hilfsbereite Schleswig-Holsteiner ein Nachtlager anbieten – manchmal auch unterm Feigenbaum im Wintergarten.

Unterwegs auf der Luftlinie erleben Vanessa und Thilo abseits der klassischen Reiserouten ein 100 Kilometer langes Abenteuer, das ihnen einiges abverlangt, was die Kameramänner Alexander Reinsch und Thomas Eichler in Bild und Ton festhalten. Ihr Lohn: tolle Zufallsbekanntschaften, Nervenkitzel und die Gewissheit: Auf die Norddeutschen kann man sich verlassen! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ostseereport – Riga Fashion Week
programme.desc:
Paris, Seoul, Tokio und New York. Alles Städte, die sich in Sachen Mode einen Namen auf dem internationalen Markt gemacht haben.

Aber auch Riga spielt in dieser Liga mit. Lettlands Hauptstadt ist immer wieder eine Überraschung, denn sie ist eines der bedeutendsten Zentren europäischer Mode – und das schon seit vielen Jahrzehnten.

Auf der Riga Fashion Week Ende Oktober präsentieren sich neue Designer*innen mit neuen Ideen und neuem Look aus Osteuropa. Auch Baiba Ladiga. Ihre Familie ist seit über 100 Jahren in dieser Welt zu Hause.

Als ihre Großmutter das Unternehmen 1920 gründet, ist Riga eine lebendige, unabhängige Stadt im Aufschwung. Neue Gebäude im ausdrucksstarken Jugendstil verleihen der Stadt ein prunkvolles Erscheinungsbild. Unterschiedliches Design und Kleidung im Art-déco-Stil streben in die Moderne. Eine eigene Modewelt entsteht.

Dann die Zäsur: der Zweite Weltkrieg. Lettland verliert seine Unabhängigkeit und wird hineingezwungen in den Staatenbund der Sowjetunion. Der Blick der Modebegeisterten geht Richtung Westen, die ihre Augen nur noch auf Paris, Mailand und New York richten.

Nach der Unabhängigkeit Lettlands 1991 wird wieder alles anders, und die Modebranche erfindet sich neu. Eine wechselvolle Geschichte der Riga Fashion Week mit ihren neuen Ideen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nordtour
programme.desc:
„Wild Lights“ im Zoo Schwerin

Bis Ende November verwandelt sich der Schweriner Zoo an den Abenden in eine faszinierende Lichtkunstwelt. Die Ausstellung „Wild Lights“ zeigt großformatige, eigens für Schwerin kuratierte Installationen. Zwischen Bäumen, Wasserflächen und Wegen entstehen besondere Szenerien, die zugleich auf den Artenschutz aufmerksam machen. Ein Team aus China hat die Figuren über mehrere Wochen aufgebaut und installiert.

Es gruselt in der Heide: Halloween-Spektakel im Freizeitpark

Der Heide Park Soltau verwandelt sich jeden Oktober vor der Winterpause in eine spektakuläre Halloween-Welt. An den Wochenenden sorgen die Horror-Live-Erschrecker der Boo-Crew für Gänsehaut. Der Hamburger Verein zählt 130 gruselbegeisterte Freiwillige und hat gerade neue Mitglieder aufgenommen. Die „Nordtour“ begleitete die 29-jährige Laura aus Dithmarschen bei ihrem ersten Einsatz.

Afrodance

Herbstzeit ist Ausgehzeit: In Hamburgs Clubs erobern afrikanische Rhythmen die Tanzflächen. Im Tanzstudio Lara in Volksdorf vermitteln Jenny Love Meyer und Lara Marie Weymar die Grundlagen der afrikanischen Tanzstile Azonto, Amapiano und Afro House. Die jungen Tänzerinnen und Tänzer lernen dabei nicht nur neue Moves, sondern auch die Geschichten und kulturellen Wurzeln der Tanzstile kennen. Für Jenny und Lara bedeutet Afrodance vor allem: gemeinsam lernen, Mut machen und Spaß haben.

Reporterin: Stencil-Workshop

Der Hamburger Künstler René Scheer ist vielseitig engagiert und verbindet in seinen Werken Streetart mit politischen und sozialen Themen. In seinem Atelier in Eidelstedt bietet er Workshops für Stencil Art an – für Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene. Dabei werden handgeschnittene Schablonen Schicht für Schicht auf Leinwände gesprüht, ganz im Stil von Banksy und der Graffitiszene. Scheer möchte seinen Teilnehmenden vor allem Mut machen, kreativ zu werden und eigene Ideen auszuprobieren. Denn bei Stencil Art gilt: Nicht jeder Fehler muss perfekt sein, vieles lässt sich einfach übersprühen.

Handpuppen gegen Enkeltrick & Co.

Bei Enkeltricks, Schockanrufen oder falschen Handwerkern geraten häufig Senioren ins Visier der Verbrecher. Die Polizei Hannover setzt deshalb bei der Prävention auf eine ungewöhnliche Unterstützung: Handpuppe Clara Korn. Zusammen mit Polizeioberkommissar Marco Weber erklärt sie Senioren, wie Betrugsversuche funktionieren und wie sich Betroffene schützen können. Mit Humor und einem Augenzwinkern schafft sie einen leichteren Zugang zu einem ernsten Thema.

Der Glocken-Spotter (Lauenburg)

Wenn Kirchenglocken erklingen, beginnt für den 23-jährigen Hendrik Hopfenblatt eine faszinierende Forschungsreise. Der Liebhaber alter Glocken untersucht Klang, Inschriften und Verzierungen und verfolgt die Spuren ihrer Gießer. In den vergangenen zehn Jahren hat Hendrik bereits rund 7000 Glocken erkundet und mehr als 1000 Türme bestiegen. Nun möchte er eine Deutschlandkarte erstellen, die die Wege der Glocken und dieses alten Handwerks sichtbar macht.

Naturmaler

Seit er elf Jahre alt ist, malt Christopher Schmidt Vögel und die Natur. Mit seiner unglaublichen Beobachtungsgabe und Artenkenntnis entdeckt er die kleinen Schönheiten und Raritäten vor der heimischen Haustür und malt sie bis ins Detail. Seine Bilder sind international preisgekrönt, er illustriert Bücher und malt für Naturausstellungen. Längst sind zu den Vögeln auch Säugetiere, Insekten und Amphibien dazugekommen. Und am liebsten malt er draußen, weil nur dort Unvorhergesehenes passieren kann. Was er da erlebt, hält er in seinen Bildern fest und schreibt darüber auch in seinen Büchern.

Porträt Thomas Schüttoff

Thomas Schüttoff hat in einem Hangar am Hildesheimer Flugplatz sein bewegtes Fliegerleben zusammengetragen. Zehntausende Exponate rund ums Fliegen: Bücher, historische Flugzeuge, eine umfangreiche Sammlung historischer Dokumente zu Charles Lindbergh, sogar die Scheinwerfer, mit denen der Film „Casablanca“ ausgeleuchtet wurde, stehen bei ihm. Aviators Farm nennt er sein Refugium, das zudem ein Kino umfasst. Natürlich wird hier geflogen, aber er nutzt seine Räume auch als Eventlocation, um Leute zusammenzubringen.

Koch-Azubi Weinhaus Uhle

Der Koch-Auszubildende Tristan Schäfer hat sich für die Deutsche Jugendmeisterschaft des DEHOGA qualifiziert. Dort tritt er gegen die besten Nachwuchskräfte seines Fachs an und vertritt das traditionsreiche Weinhaus Uhle in Schwerin. Das Restaurant liegt im historischen Herzen der Stadt und ist mit einem Michelin-Stern ausgezeichnet. Für Tristan ist die Teilnahme eine große Herausforderung und zugleich eine wichtige Chance auf seinem Weg in die Berufswelt. Bei der Vorbereitung zeigt er, wie Tradition und moderne Küche in seinem Ausbildungsbetrieb zusammenfinden.

Used-Look für Modelleisenbahnen

Vielen Modelleisenbahnfreunden sehen Modelle, die frisch aus der Verpackung kommen, oft zu neu und wenig authentisch aus. Heiko Wolbink aus Neuenhaus verleiht ihnen mit Spezialfarben, Wattestäbchen und Luftdruck realistische Gebrauchsspuren. In seiner Kellerwerkstatt macht der gelernte Maurer aus Serienmodellen individuelle Unikate mit Ruß, Rost und Wasserverläufen. Zu seinen größten Aufträgen gehörten 40 Loks und 250 Waggons für das Miniatur Wunderland Hamburg. Seine detailreich gealterten Züge sind inzwischen so beliebt, dass sogar die Polizei auf ihn aufmerksam wurde. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: DAS! Rote Sofa
programme.desc:
Gast DAS! Rote Sofa: Anselm Nathanael Pahnke, Abenteurer und Filmemacher

Einmal mit dem Fahrrad durch die Wüste fahren, bei Sonne, Hitze und mit wenig Wasser. Der Abenteurer und Filmemacher Anselm Pahnke hat eine Reise hinter sich, die ihm viel abverlangte.

Für die neue Folge der NDR-Reihe „Young Adventurers“ durchquerte er gemeinsam mit seinem Freund Raphael Bitsos Marokko vom tiefsten Süden bis in die Königsstadt Fès. Auf historischen Karawanenpfaden, durch Sandsturm, Kälte und die enge M'Goun-Schlucht, erleben die beiden ein Land voller Widersprüche – rau und herzerwärmend zugleich.

Bewegende Begegnungen, gemeinsames Fastenbrechen im Ramadan und Gespräche über Freiheit, Frieden und Identität prägen die Reise.

Auf dem Roten Sofa verrät der Schleswig-Holsteiner auch, wie wichtig Freundschaft bei so einer Tour ist und warum er sich zu Hause im sozialen Wohnungsbau engagiert. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: buten un binnen; regionalmagazin
programme.desc:
Das bewegt Bremen, Bremerhaven und das Umland – das Regionalmagazin greift auf, worüber die Menschen in der Region sprechen. Kritisch, direkt, ganz nah dran.

Hier gibt es Platz für politische Diskussionen, Berichte über gesellschaftliche Ereignisse, Reportagen aus dem Leben, kritische Interviews, Kultur und Musik. Auch der Sport kommt nicht zu kurz.

Von Montag bis Freitag immer mit der Wochenserie. buten un binnen informiert und unterhält zum Feierabend, täglich um 19:30 Uhr im Radio Bremen Fernsehen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: buten un binnen; wetter
programme.desc:
Das Magazin berichtet täglich aus Bremen und Bremerhaven über das aktuelle Geschehen in der Region.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen dabei die Menschen und das, was sie bewegt. Häufig geht es um gesellschaftlich relevante Themen, die das Leben vor Ort prägen.

Vorgestellt werden zudem engagierte Persönlichkeiten, die sich für das Allgemeinwohl einsetzen oder mit besonderen Ideen auffallen. Auch Feste, Jubiläen und regionale Ereignisse werden regelmäßig begleitet.

So entsteht ein vielfältiges Bild aus Alltag, Engagement und Gemeinschaft in der Region. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc:
Seit 1952 wird die Nachrichtensendung präsentiert.

Sie informiert täglich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen.

Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein.

Neben den aktuellen Nachrichten werden Hintergründe, Zusammenhänge und Einordnungen vermittelt, die das Geschehen in einen größeren Kontext setzen. Dabei steht eine präzise, sachliche und unabhängige Berichterstattung im Mittelpunkt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Echt, Katrin Sass! Das Porträt
programme.desc: Anlässlich ihres 70. Geburtstags würdigt der NDR Katrin Sass, eine der faszinierendsten und prägendsten Charakterdarstellerinnen Deutschlands. Von ihren frühen, großen Erfolgen in der DDR über den internationalen Kinohit „Good Bye, Lenin!“ bis hin zu ihrer prägenden Rolle als Ex-Staatsanwältin Karin Lossow im „Usedom-Krimi“ erfindet sich die Mecklenburgerin seit Jahrzehnten immer wieder neu. \n\nDoch das Porträt blendet auch die Schattenseiten nicht aus: Offen und schonungslos spricht Sass über schwere persönliche Krisen, ihren Kampf gegen die Alkoholsucht und ihren mutigen Weg zurück ins Leben.

programme.title: Unsere legendären Schauspielstars
programme.sub-title: Von Mario Adorf bis Romy Schneider
programme.desc:
Glamour und große Auftritte wie in Hollywood? Auch Deutschland hat eine beeindruckende Riege von Schauspiellegenden, die weit über die Leinwand hinaus faszinieren. Von Romy Schneider über Heinz Rühmann bis Hildegard Knef – schon vor Jahrzehnten sorgten deutsche Talente für internationales Aufsehen. Und auch heute begeistert eine vielfältige Star-Riege, von Mario Adorf und Iris Berben bis hin zu Elyas M’Barek und – unvergessen – Jan Fedder († 2019).

In dieser Dokumentation stehen 16 deutsche Schauspielgrößen im Rampenlicht – acht Frauen und acht Männer, aus allen Regionen des Landes. Sie sind mehr als nur Stars: Sie bewegen, inspirieren und haben mit ihren Geschichten ein Stück Kultur geprägt.

Prominente wie Meltem Kaptan, Ingolf Lück, Esther Schweins, Johanna Gastdorf und Jan-Gregor Kremp, Radost Bokel, Ann-Kathrin Kramer und Musiker Guildo Horn blicken hinter die Kulissen und teilen persönliche Erinnerungen.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez les Loud
The Loud House
programme.desc: Après deux saisons triomphantes, la famille Loud revient en grande forme sur Gulli ! Faire partie d'une famille nombreuse ce n'est pas tous les jours facile. Mais quand, en plus, il n'y a qu'un seul garçon entouré de ses 10 soeurs, les journées sont... mouvementées. Bienvenue chez les Loud, c'est l'histoire d'une famille pas comme les autres au quotidien totalement déjanté !Dans la ville de Royal Woods vit la famille Loud : une famille nombreuse composée de Lincoln, un jeune garçon de 11 ans et de ses 10 soeurs. La vie de Lincoln est tout sauf ennuyeuse ! Avec cinq grandes soeurs et cinq petites soeurs, le mieux pour lui est de toujours avoir un plan en réserve.

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc: Für Hannover 96 kommt es nach dem missglückten Trainerdebüt von Sandro Wagner auf eine schnelle Reaktion an. Beim 0:3 in Magdeburg offenbarten die Niedersachsen vor allem in der ersten Halbzeit erhebliche Probleme. Bereits in der dritten Minute führte ein Fehler im Spielaufbau zum Rückstand, kurz vor der Pause legte Emmanuel Iyoha nach. Auch nach dem Seitenwechsel fehlten Hannover die Durchschlagskraft und die nötige Konsequenz im Abschluss. Marcel Hartel traf bei seinem Versuch auf den Anschlusstreffer lediglich den Pfosten, ehe Mateusz Żukowski in der Schlussphase den Endstand herstellte. Nun steht Wagner vor seinem ersten Ligaspiel als 96-Trainer auf heimischem Boden.\n\nMit dem FC St. Pauli wartet nun ein Gegner, der zuletzt Selbstvertrauen tanken konnte. Die Hamburger bezwangen den Karlsruher SC mit 2:0. Zuvor hatte die Mannschaft von Marcel Rapp gegen Energie Cottbus ein 1:1 geholt und den VfL Wolfsburg mit 1:0 geschlagen. Die jüngsten Resultate sprechen somit für eine stabilere Entwicklung der Kiezkicker. Zusätzliche Brisanz erhält das Duell durch den Sommertransfer von Marcel Hartel, der mit den 96ern erstmals auf seinen früheren Klub trifft. Mit den Hamburgern feierte der Mittelfeldspieler 2024 den Bundesliga-Aufstieg. Für die Niedersachsen wiederum sammelte der 30-Jährige bereits vier Torbeteiligungen in sieben Pflichtspieleinsätzen. (Redaktionsschluss: Freitag, den 16.10.2026).

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Wanneer een bijdehante zwarte oplichter uit Zuid-Centraal LA wordt teruggevoerd naar het middeleeuwse Engeland, leidt hij de omverwerping van een kwaadaardige koning en wint hij het hart van een protofeministische vrouw.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Jane Hammond is een voorbeeldige vrouw die getrouwd is met Bill, een van de slechtste mannen die er in de stad rondloopt. Als Bill zich tegen zijn eigen bende keert en op een dag halfdood thuis komt met acht kogels in zijn rug, neemt Jane zelf een wapen ter handen om orde op zaken te stellen.

programme.title: Hellboy: Blood & Iron
programme.desc: Wanneer Hellboy, Liz Sherman en Abe Sapien de opdracht krijgen om het door spoken geteisterde landhuis van een miljardair in de publiciteit te onderzoeken, ontdekken ze een complot om een ​​mooie maar monsterlijke vampier uit het verleden van professor Bruttenholm weer tot leven te wekken.

programme.title: Ben Collins Stunt Driver
programme.desc: Deze documentaire volgt de professionele en toonaangevende stuntrijder Ben Collins, voorheen beter bekend als The Stig in 'Top Gear'. Hij probeert nu om de beste stuntauto voor een achtervolging te vinden.

programme.title: Vanguard - Elite Special Force
programme.desc: Tang Huanting (Jackie Chan) is de oprichter van Vanguard; de beste en meest gerespecteerde beveiligingsagency, met klanten over de hele wereld. Als de Chinese zakenman Qin Guoli in Londen wordt ontvoerd door militanten uit het Midden-Oosten komen de Vanguard leden direct in actie.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: Anderhalf jaar na een grote virusuitbraak is meer dan 89% van de wereld uitgeroeid. Energie- en waternetwerken zijn kapot en de laatste overlevende worden aan hun lot overgelaten. Zo goed als iedereen komt te overlijden na weer een nieuwe uitbraak. Behalve Sarah.

programme.title: Everly
programme.desc: Everly (Salma Hayek) is klaar met de maffiawereld waar haar voormalige vriend Taiko, een gevaarlijke maffiabaas van de Yakuza, de touwtjes in handen heeft. Wanneer ze besluit om als informant aan de slag te gaan bij de politie, is Taiko woest.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,..

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good..

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: In Search of Shunde Ep.1
programme.desc: A Bite of Shunde tells the stories of Shunde locals through food, showcasing this city's heritage and present-day life. It looks at the craftsmanship Shunde people apply in the kitchen and beyond, and the dedicated, artisan mentality behind their renowned culinary culture. Through their attitude toward a simple home-cooked meal, we get insights into their values and way of life.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there's the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there's plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou's tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an "Emporium of the World".

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai's Yushu Prefecture is one of China's key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders' daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Four Faces of Muqam
programme.desc: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is an integral part of Xinjiang culture, a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You..

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

Anna Pancaldi visits marine protected areas, including the Smart Bay of Santa Teresa and the port of La Spezia, where researchers study "alien species". Finally, we learn about the underwater internet, an innovation from Sapienza University of Rome led by Professor Chiara Petrioli and the WSENSE team.

programme.title: Med Nations 08 Egypt
programme.desc: Journey along the northern coast of Egypt, where the Mediterranean meets the land of the pharaohs. From the historic streets and libraries of Alexandria to charming coastal towns and bustling markets, Egypt reveals a unique blend of ancient heritage, vibrant culture, and seaside traditions that continue to shape life along its Mediterranean shores.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine

programme.title: il pane, le torte, la pizza
programme.desc: Accompany, contain, support: three key concepts defining Italy's iconic culinary creations—bread, cakes, and pizza. Bread, a fundamental staple, complements dishes while holding symbolic meaning. Savory pies, rooted in medieval tradition, have remained unchanged through centuries. Lastly, pizza, an ancient grain-based dish, achieved global fame after merging with tomatoes in Naples. Massimo Montanari leads us through this rich and flavorful journey.

She visits the stunning Alhambra, enjoys a delicious tapas tour, and experiences the passion of flamenco. Granada’s blend of Moorish heritage and modern energy makes it one of Spain’s most captivating cities. Special thanks to Gayle for an incredible tapas tour.

From the rhythm of the hand loom to the finishing details, discover the patience, imagination, and skill behind her craft.

Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus.

programme.title: Origini
programme.sub-title: S01:E02 Tra Reggio e Messina lo Stretto necessario
programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. Diver Domenico Majolino and marine biologist Simona Ratti explain its natural wonders, while Vincenzo Annuario tells the story of the Cariddi ferry, reborn after serving in the navy. At the National Archaeological Museum of Reggio Calabria, we discover the legacy of Magna Grecia and the famous Riace Bronzes. The 1908 earthquake that devastated Messina and Reggio Calabria is commemorated at the Regional Museum of Messina with the exhibition "1908 City Museum".

programme.title: De Smurfen

Limits are shattered on the dirt as superstars like Weston Anderson and Fernando Martinez face off against hungry rookies in a series of punishing JCB Racing brackets and gravity-defying Best Trick competitions. Rivals like Adam Anderson and Tristan England look to defend their dominance, while fierce competitors like Jamie Sullivan and Chris Koehler push their 1,500-horsepower machines to the absolute edge to claim the BKT overall event championship. In a high-stakes showdown that blends the raw power of Monster Jam with elite freestyle motocross, eight top-tier teams battle for supremacy on a track described as "sticky like bubble gum". Watch as Weston Anderson in Grave Digger attempts to set a blistering pace against fierce competition from Fernando Martinez in El Toro Loco and hometown hero Chuckie Pauken. From the high-speed precision of JCB Racing to the gravity-defying maneuvers of the Two-Wheel Skills Challenge, every moment is a quest for the critical points needed to crown the night's overall champion.

programme.desc: Naruto en de anderen zetten hun zoektocht voort naar aanwijzingen die leiden naar Gennou of zijn plan. Tijdens een onderzoek van de Ninja Academy ontdekken ze een verdachte trainingspost die tot een nog engere ontdekking leidt.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Nu de stad Konoha in kaart is gebracht met explosieve tags, moet er een beslissing worden genomen: of ze worden verwijderd, of de hele stad wordt geëvacueerd. Er is echter iets vreemds aan deze tags, kunnen ze ontdekken wat het is.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Terwijl Shikamaru probeert uit te zoeken wat Gennou nu weer van plan is, vecht Naruto tegen Gennou in de Grote Stenen Gezichten. Kan Shikamaru Gennou's volgende stap in het plan stoppen voordat het te laat is.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto en Sakura presenteren een speciale recap-aflevering met de top vijf gevechten tot nu toe. Er zijn ook interviews met een aantal van het team, en misschien zelfs een aantal van de vijand..

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto ontmoet een meisje genaamd Yakumo dat een verrassend talent heeft voor vernietiging. Kort daarna neemt Kurenai Yuhi, leider van Team 8, een verrassende beslissing en Naruto is vastbesloten uit te zoeken waarom.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto sluipt 's nachts Yakumo's landhuis binnen en droomt dat Kurenai dreigde Yakumo's vermogens te verzegelen. Hij ontdekt dan dat dit de reden is waarom ze het team verliet, maar Kurenai weigert meer te vertellen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Terwijl Kurenai probeert te ontsnappen met Yakumo, Naruto en Sakura, arriveren Team 8 en Might Gai om hulp te bieden. We leren wat van de geschiedenis tussen Kurenai en Yakumo en ontdekken waarom de dingen zijn gelopen zoals ze zijn gelopen.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto, Kurenai, Yakumo en Team 8 keren terug naar Konoha voor een schokkende ontdekking. Kan dit echt de realiteit zijn of is het allemaal een zieke illusie.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.sub-title: Het gevlekte beest vs. het staarloze beest
programme.desc: Naruto en de leden van Team 8 gaan Yakumo's huis binnen om haar met Kurenai aan te treffen. Er wordt onthuld dat er mogelijk een mysterieuze entiteit achter dit alles zit. Kan de groep de waarheid op tijd ontdekken.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto en Kiba moeten een man genaamd Shinemon begeleiden die een zeldzaam en waardevol artefact vervoert. Maar als Bandieten het artefact stelen, kan het tweetal het dan terughalen en Shinemon in leven houden.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura en Lee zijn gestuurd om een gevangene genaamd Gantetsu te escorteren naar de hoofdstad van Forest Country. Hun taak is alleen om de escortegroep te ondersteunen voor het geval er iets misgaat, wat onvermijdelijk het geval is..

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De drie schurken uit de zwaarbeveiligde gevangenis
programme.desc: Nu de gebeurtenissen in Rice Field Country achter de rug zijn, bereidt iedereen zich voor op de training. Maar al snel duikt er een nieuwe dreiging op. Herinner je je Mizuki nog? Hij is terug en hij is van plan om uit Konoha's gevangenis te ontsnappen, samen met twee domme, dikke broers..

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Ton Ton! Ik reken op je!
programme.desc: Shizune achtervolgt Mizuki die ontsnapt is uit de Maximum Security Prison, maar wordt door hem en de broers Raijin en Fujin overwonnen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Een nieuw team! Twee mensen en een hond?
programme.desc: Naruto heeft problemen met de twee broers en Iruka heeft zijn deel van de problemen met Mizuki. Iruka worstelt om te proberen de oude Mizuki terug te krijgen, maar hij heeft niet veel succes. - Ondertussen, als het er slecht uitziet voor Naruto, kunnen 3 bevriende Ninja's zijn dag nog redden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto's back-up is gearriveerd en dat zijn Shikamaru, Ino en Chouji. Ze vertellen Naruto dat ze voor de broers zullen zorgen. Naruto vertrekt om Iruka in te halen, die aan het vechten is met Mizuki. Kan Naruto aankomen voordat Mizuki Iruka doodt? En kunnen Shikamaru, Ino en Chouji de broers tegenhouden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Overgebleven ambitie: de schaduw van Orochimaru
programme.desc: Naruto en zijn team beginnen hun eerste ninja-missies met saaie en onbelangrijke taken. Naruto is moe en boos en uit zijn frustratie op de Hokage.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Een botsing van het lot: je kunt me niet neerhalen!
programme.desc: Mizuki is vastbesloten om Naruto en Iruka te laten lijden en het lijkt erop dat hij de overhand heeft met zijn verbeterde kracht en snelheid. Shikamaru, Ino en Chouji zitten ook aan hun limiet en nu zijn Fuujin en Raijin vrij. Kan Tsunade op tijd komen om te helpen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: De zoektocht naar de zeldzame Bikochu kever
programme.desc: Naruto kan Sasuke niet zoeken vanwege Tsunade's bevelen, terwijl Kiba en Hinata zich afvragen hoe ze hem kunnen helpen. Shino herinnert zich een speciaal soort insect dat, als het wordt gevonden, Sasuke gemakkelijk zou kunnen opsporen.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Wat is het verschil? Lijken niet alle insecten op elkaar?
programme.desc: De groep worstelt om een Bikouchuu te vinden, maar lijkt telkens te falen. Als het begint te regenen beseffen ze dat ze nog maar één kans hebben om hem te vinden, zal Hinata's Byakugan genoeg zijn.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden The Movie: The Will of Fire
programme.desc: In alle grote shinobi-naties zijn ninja's met speciale bloedlijnen spoorloos verdwenen. Naruto en de rest van Team Kakashi hebben verwondingen opgelopen tijdens hun onderzoek en gaan terug naar Konoha om te genezen, maar niet lang na hun terugkeer verschijnt er een verschijning van een jongen in de lucht.

programme.title: Naruto Shippuden The Movie: Blood Prison
programme.desc: Na een valse beschuldiging van poging tot moord op de Raikage wordt Naruto naar Blood Prison gestuurd - een eilandgevangenis omringd door dodelijke draaikolken. De gevangenis is ontworpen voor veroordeelde shinobi en wordt bestuurd door de genadeloze directeur Mui, wiens ijzeren regel de gevangenen geen hoop op ontsnapping geeft.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Een strijd van insecten! De bedriegers en de bedrogenen
programme.desc: Met Hinata's veiligheid in gevaar moet de groep een manier zien te vinden om haar te redden en tegelijkertijd de Bikouchuu te beschermen. Elke keer als de ene kant een voordeel lijkt te hebben, onthult de andere kant weer een nieuwe truc. Als de dageraad nadert, hebben ze niet lang meer te gaan.... lukt het ze.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.sub-title: Naruto: Schiet op, Byakugan! Dit is mijn Ninja-manier!
programme.desc: Nu de groep in de val zit, sluit Shino een deal om de Bikouchuu te ruilen voor Hinata. Helaas voor de tegenstanders is Hinata ontsnapt, waardoor de deal waardeloos is geworden. Ze beginnen aan te vallen, maar kan Hinata opdagen om de dag te redden.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Als Naruto drie vreemdelingen redt, wordt hij weer in een missie meegesleurd. Deze keer wil hij er echter niet aan meedoen. Tot hij hoort dat er misschien een verband is met Akatsuki. Met Neji, Lee en Tenten als zijn teamgenoten, zal hij de informatie vinden die hij zoekt.

programme.title: Indian Summer

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: Caernarfon - In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris "Flamebaster" in de rijke culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Hij ontdekt de vergeten oestercultuur van de Menai Strait, kookt een klassieke Victoriaanse beef & oyster pie, en serveert sappige brisket buns aan de band Doniau Cudd. Ook bezoekt hij een duurzame paddenstoelenboerderij en proeft hij fine dining bij restaurant Sheeps and Leeks. De aflevering eindigt met een visfeest op zijn oude woonwijk, met vers gevangen makreel van lokale vissers.

programme.title: Op Hete Kolen

Onze chef prepareert een heerlijke kruidenolie waarmee hij de sappige bout van boven tot onder inwrijft en die de zuivere smaak van het zachte lamsvlees helemaal ondersteunt. Hierbij rolt chef Michaël courgette rolletjes met geitenkaas en serveert hij een zuiderse couscous. Als hapje voor de gasten staat er een nem op het menu, een soort kleine loempia waarmee je je gasten kan verwennen tijdens het aperitief.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.desc: På slutten av 1800-tallet styres Mexico av penger, makt og korrupsjon. Sara er datter av en rik bankmann, og Maria er vokst opp blant fattige bønder.

programme.desc: Flis; rotten sensei; føler at hans fire ungdoms skilpaddedisipler har vokst fra hverandre og trenger å knytte bånd for å beseire et eldgammelt monster.

programme.desc: ‘Vault’ utspiller seg i 1975 og er inspirert av en sann historie om en gruppe småkjeltringer som forsøker å gjennomføre det største ranet i amerikansk historie.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Et ungt par er truet på livet av en ekstremistisk milits og må flykte fra sin misjonsstasjon i Kalahariørkenen. Men når flyet deres styrter i et dyrereservat, må de kjempe mot både mennesker og villdyr for å overleve.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Surf And Turf
programme.desc: New Hampshire has only 19 kilometers of coastline and short summers, all the more reason Shauna Fraser takes every opportunity to be by the sea. In the sheltered harbor of Rye, Shauna also targets inner attitude with yoga on a paddleboard.

programme.title: Model And The Bushmen, The
programme.desc: This is the story of an incredible adventure: a young woman from Norway moves into the wild and joins the last Bushmen hunters in Namibia. Every morning, the women set out to forage and the men sneak into the bush to hunt, carrying little else but homemade bows and arrows as they walk through the wilderness.

programme.title: Meteor Menace
programme.desc: On February 15th, 2013, out of the blue, a meteorite exploded in the earth’s atmosphere above the Russian region of Chelyabinsk. The event is a reminder of the ever-present 'Meteor Menace' and the need to understand more about these missiles from outer space.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: Butterflies surely are the most fancied species inside the insect world. Their beautiful colouring and their graceful flight appeal to everyone. There are close to 4000 types of Butterflies – today many of them are endangered due to the loss of their habitat.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.sub-title: Children of the Sun - Wild Bees
programme.desc: Most people associate honey producing insects with the name “BEE“. Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the far north-east of Georgia, on the border with Russia, the Abano Pass leads to lofty heights. At almost 3000 metres it is the highest passable road in the Great Caucasus. It winds its way up dizzyingly steep slopes. On wild paths, it leads through a fascinating landscape.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: NAVIGATING GLOBAL ECONOMIC CHANGE Exclusive with WEF President
programme.desc: The year 2026 marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the World Economic Forum's Beijing Representative Office. CGTN's Guan Xin speaks with Alois Zwinggi, president and CEO of WEF, to look back on nearly five decades of cooperation between WEF and China, examine the future of globalization and explore how 'China Opportunity 2.0' can further advance global cooperation in supply chain resilience, green technology and AI governance.

programme.title: Tennis Australia exec on the Australian Open's China push
programme.desc: China is taking center court in the Australian Open's global growth strategy. The Grand Slam has kicked off its 2027 China campaign in Beijing, aiming to engage fans through localized digital content, live events, retail and Chinese cultural Ambassadors. Tennis Australia says its long-term investment is paying off, with China now one of the tournament's largest international markets.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,..
