programme.title: Cleo & Cuquin
programme.desc: Targeted towards preschoolers, "Cleo & Cuquin" is an animated program based on the classic "Familia Telerin" cartoon. It follows the Telerin kids, Cleo and Cuquin and their friends Tete, Pelusin, Colitas, and Maripi. Together, these friends find ways to play together and use their imagination while doing so --they pretend to be astronauts, scientists, pilots, and all other manner of professions in order to see that their job gets done. "Cleo & Cuquin" is about friendship and learning how to be a good friend to those around them.

programme.title: El Chapulín Colorado
programme.desc: "No contaban con mi astucia", "que no panda el cúnico (pánico)", "lo tenía fríamente calculado", son las frases famosas de este "superhéroe" de la serie clásica dirigida a toda la familia, muy reconocida en la cultura hispanohablante por varias generaciones. Él aparece al rescate cada vez que alguien resulta en una situación difícil y el sujeto en problemas siempre menciona la frase "Y ahora ¿quién podrá defenderme?". El chapulín colorado es la representación antagónica de un superhéroe típico, es miedoso, torpe, no deduce la situación tan rápidamente, crea más problemas y no resuelve nada, pero al final parece salir todo bien de una forma sorpresiva, gracias a la ayuda de la víctima. Sus acciones disparatadas son divertidas, llenas de humor y muy entretenidas.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: El Chapulín Colorado
programme.desc: "No contaban con mi astucia", "que no panda el cúnico (pánico)", "lo tenía fríamente calculado", son las frases famosas de este "superhéroe" de la serie clásica dirigida a toda la familia, muy reconocida en la cultura hispanohablante por varias generaciones. Él aparece al rescate cada vez que alguien resulta en una situación difícil y el sujeto en problemas siempre menciona la frase "Y ahora ¿quién podrá defenderme?". El chapulín colorado es la representación antagónica de un superhéroe típico, es miedoso, torpe, no deduce la situación tan rápidamente, crea más problemas y no resuelve nada, pero al final parece salir todo bien de una forma sorpresiva, gracias a la ayuda de la víctima. Sus acciones disparatadas son divertidas, llenas de humor y muy entretenidas.

programme.title: AutoLAnd - Motorkultur in Los Angeles

programme.title: Garagengold

programme.sub-title: Kölner Klunker - Axel Roschker und seine Schätze

programme.title: Road House
programme.desc: Dalton verschlägt es in ein Kaff irgendwo in Missouri. Hier herrschen ein Bösewicht und seine Bande, doch Dalton sagt diesen schnell den Kampf an und beginnt, in der Stadt aufzuräumen.

programme.title: Code Ava: Trained to kill
programme.desc: Die Profikillerin Ava arbeitet für eine Geheimorganisation und schaltet weltweit hochrangige Zielpersonen aus. Als dann jedoch einer ihrer Aufträge misslingt, wird sie selbst zur Zielscheibe und muss um ihr Überleben kämpfen.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: Marcus Luttrell und sein Team von Navy Seals sollen im Juni 2005 in Afghanistan einen Taliban-Anführer eliminieren. Dabei geraten sie jedoch in einen Hinterhalt. Bald stehen sie einer Übermacht von Taliban-Kämpfern in aussichtslosem Kampf gegenüber.

programme.title: R.E.D.: Älter, Härter, Besser
programme.desc: Frank Moses und seine Freunde sind CIA-Rentner und stellen für ihren ehemaligen Auftraggeber eine grosse Gefahr dar. Deshalb sollen sie ausgeschaltet werden. Doch das lassen die Alt-Agenten nicht mit sich machen und decken lieber Verschwörungen auf.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Das gefallene Königreich
programme.desc: Owen Grady und Claire Dearing kehren auf die Insel Isla Nublar zurück, um die Dinosaurier vor einem ausbrechenden Vulkan zu retten. Dort müssen sie sich gegen Jäger wehren und sie enthüllen eine Verschwörung, die den gesamten Planeten bedroht.

programme.title: The Best Man
programme.desc: Als skrupellose Gangster die Kontrolle in einem abgelegenen Luxushotel übernehmen, müssen sich ehemalige Special-Ops-Soldaten auf ihren Verstand und ihre Ausbildung verlassen, um eine Hochzeitsgesellschaft zu retten, die als Geisel genommen wurde.

programme.title: Der Pate: Teil II
programme.desc: Der junge Vito Corleone überlebt als Einziger seiner Familie eine Mafiafehde. Er arbeitet sich zum mächtigen Unterweltboss der USA hoch. 40 Jahre später übernimmt sein Sohn das Erbe, dessen Grausamkeit auch vor der eigenen Familie nicht haltmacht.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Der mürrische Viehbaron George Washington McLintock herrscht mit eiserner Hand über sein Territorium. Immer wieder muss er zwischen den neu ankommenden Siedlern und den alteingesessenen Indianerstämmen vermitteln.

programme.title: Free Willy 2: Freiheit in Gefahr
programme.desc: Zwei Jahre nachdem Jesse dem zahmen Orca-Wal Willy zum Sprung in die Freiheit verholfen hat, kommt es zu einem Wiedersehen mit dem alten Freund, denn er und seine Familie werden von einem brennenden Ölteppich bedroht.

programme.title: Harry und Sally
programme.desc: Als Harry und Sally sich zum ersten Mal begegnen, sind sie nicht gerade begeistert voneinander. Doch in den Folgejahren treffen sie sich zufällig immer wieder. Dabei bemerken sie, dass sie meist mit ähnlichen Herausforderungen konfrontiert sind.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore

programme.title: 13h15, le samedi
programme.desc: Jacky Mercier a passé 50 ans au chevet de ses tomates, créant notamment des variétés rares de toutes les couleurs. Elles font sa fierté depuis toujours mais celui qui est surnommé "le roi de la tomate" a décidé de prendre sa retraite. Il l'évoquait déjà il y a trois ans et là c'est chose faite, il a transmis son exploitation de Frontenay-sur-Dive dans la Vienne. Mais ça c'est sur le papier, car la réalité est bien différente : pas facile pour Jacky de s'éloigner de ses chères tomates.

programme.desc: "C'est bon à savoir" décrypte les bénéfices pour la santé de la consommation des fruits et légumes et analyse leur mode de culture, sans oublier de parler d'environnement. Avec la complicité d'experts, ce programme revient quelques idées reçues.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
programme.sub-title: Affaire Francisca da Silva, meurtre par procuration
programme.desc: Au Portugal, à deux heures de Lisbonne, le village d'Alcaçovas est écrasé de chaleur en ce mois d'août 2007. David Campos Da Silva, un portugais qui vit en France passe ses vacances ici. Mais son séjour bascule subitement dans l'horreur quand il découvre un soir sa femme assassinée chez lui.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?
programme.sub-title: Affaire Véronique Lardé, la veuve noire du Nord
programme.desc: Un corps d'homme retrouvé nu, en position foetale, dans un cimetière militaire du Pas-de-Calais. C'est la terrible découverte d'un jardinier un jour de novembre 2011. Qu'est-il arrivé à Frédéric Butanowicz, 36 ans ? Les gendarmes vont mener une enquête minutieuse et découvrir l'incroyable manipulation dont la victime faisait l'objet. En 2016, accusée du meurtre de son compagnon, Véronique Lardé, 45 ans, s'est suicidée au soir du premier jour de son procès aux assises.

programme.title: Journée 1 : ASM Clermont Auvergne vs Leinster Rugby
programme.desc: Pour la 1re journée de la Champions Cup 2026/2027, l'ASM Clermont Auvergne accueille, au stade Marcel-Michelin, les redoutables Irlandais du Leinster pour un choc d'ouverture majeur au sein du Groupe 1. Après avoir bataillé les saisons passées pour retrouver l'élite européenne, les Jaune et Bleu de l'ASM héritent d'une poule extrêmement relevée. Ouvrir la compétition à domicile face au géant de Dublin est un immense défi pour mesurer les ambitions auvergnates sur la scène continentale. Habitué des phases finales et finaliste malheureux de l'édition 2024, le Leinster se déplace dans le "temple" auvergnat avec son armada d'internationaux de l'équipe d'Irlande.

programme.title: Tout le monde a son mot à dire
programme.desc: Une gymnastique quotidienne de l'esprit pour s'amuser avec la langue française et enrichir en même temps sa culture générale. Deux équipes jouent en répondant à des questions sur des thèmes extrêmement variés. Chacune est constituée d'un candidat épaulé par deux personnalités : humoristes, comédiens, journalistes ou encore chanteurs.

programme.title: N'oubliez pas les paroles
programme.desc: Accompagnés par un orchestre, les candidats chantent en karaoké. Mais les paroles affichées ne sont pas complètes. A eux de combler les vides. Pour cela, ils doivent se souvenir des mots exacts de la chanson. Dans la joie et la bonne humeur, ils se livrent à cet exercice périlleux, tout en donnant de la voix, car s'ils n'oublient pas les paroles, ils n'oublient pas pour autant de donner la preuve de leurs talents de vocalistes. Une compétition bon enfant, qui ne se prend pas trop au sérieux et donne envie de se lever à son tour de son canapé pour chanter à tue-tête en se trémoussant devant le petit écran.

programme.title: Ascension et déclin du nazisme
programme.desc: Après l'incendie du parlement en 1933, le président Hindenburg signe un décret qui suspend la liberté d'expression. De plus, Hitler a obtenu un vote majoritaire lors d'élections simulées et de référendums organisés à son propre avantage.

programme.title: Historiquement Show
programme.desc: Jean-Christophe Buisson reçoit Emmanuel Maury pour son livre "Le Roman du palais Bourbon" et Christine Oddo pour son livre "Jennie, la femme qui a fait Churchill". Laure Dautriche chronique le livre "Enigma, le dossier secret des espions français".

programme.title: Les machines de guerre nazies
programme.desc: L'historien James Holland nous emmène dans le cockpit des machines vedettes des nazis comme le ME109, et nous apprend comment de superbes avions tels que le JU88 ont été ruinés par l'obsession de Hitler pour les bombardements en piqué.

programme.title: Les machines de guerre nazies
programme.desc: L'historien James Holland découvre la vérité derrière les redoutables divisions Panzer de Hitler, de l'inoffensif Panzer II à l'énorme tank Tigre.

programme.title: C'est un vrai complot !
programme.desc: Cet épisode explore la conjuration de Catilina. En 63 avant Jésus-Christ, le sénateur Lucius Sergius Catilina ourdit un complot de grande ampleur, visant à éliminer une partie de l'élite politique romaine et à s'emparer du pouvoir politique suprême.

programme.title: Grèce antique, les chroniques de l'ombre
programme.desc: Découverte de la guerre du Péloponnèse, sanglante guerre fratricide entre Athènes et Sparte qui secoua la Grèce et mit fin à l'Âge d'or. Des experts internationaux explorent des ruines, des tombes massives et des champs de bataille.

programme.title: Grèce antique, les chroniques de l'ombre
programme.sub-title: Alexandre le Grand, la conquête sans limites
programme.desc: Comment Philippe II a bâti une grande puissance militaire. Son fils Alexandre a ensuite conquis un immense empire avec son armée. Cela marque le début de la dernière grande période de la Grèce : l'hellénisme.

programme.title: Secrets d'empires
programme.sub-title: Les grecs : dieux, triomphes et tragédies
programme.desc: Au 5e siècle avant Jésus-Christ, les Grecs parviennent à repousser une invasion menée par l'armée perse, la plus puissante du monde. Les Grecs emmènent dans leur sillage les fondements de la culture et des institutions politiques occidentales.

programme.title: Quand l'histoire fait dates
programme.desc: Mystique et béguine, Marguerite Porete est exécutée par le feu à Paris en 1310 pour avoir écrit un livre jugé hérétique par l'Église. Dans le contexte des grands procès politiques de Philippe le Bel, est-ce le prélude à la chasse aux sorcières ?

programme.title: Sorcières, le premier féminicide de l'Histoire
programme.desc: Les sorcières étaient considérées comme des femmes indépendantes et puissantes qui défiaient les normes patriarcales de leur époque. Guérisseuses, sages-femmes, vieilles femmes, marginales, prostituées : toute femme qui défiait les attentes sociales.

programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute
programme.sub-title: Léonard de Vinci, l'homme du mystère
programme.desc: Léonard de Vinci, considéré comme un génie universel, n'a laissé que 12 tableaux authentifiés, aucune sculpture, et quelques carnets de dessins, retrouvés en 1880.

programme.title: L'ombre d'un doute
programme.desc: Florence rayonne dans toute l'Europe comme la cité des arts. C'est dans cette ville de Toscane que, vers le XIIIe siècle, apparaît un courant qu'on appellera bientôt la Renaissance.

programme.title: Historiquement Show
programme.desc: Jean-Christophe Buisson reçoit Emmanuel Maury pour "Le Roman du palais Bourbon" et Christine Oddo pour "Jennie. La femme qui a fait Churchill". Laure Dautriche chronique "Enigma, le dossier secret des espions français".

programme.title: Jérusalem, la construction de la cité de Dieu
programme.desc: Jérusalem, théâtre de plus de 3000 ans d'histoire et berceau des religions monothéistes. Ces dernières ont influencé les constructions au fil du temps et ont fait de Jérusalem une cité totalement à part au niveau architectural mais aussi historique.

programme.title: La cité oubliée de Ramsès II
programme.desc: En 2022, pour la première fois, une équipe d'archéologues menée par le professeur Henning Franzmeier entreprend des fouilles dans le palais même de Ramsès II, dans la cité mythique de Pi-Ramsès.

programme.title: maintower

programme.title: Nachtcafé
programme.sub-title: Ich! Ich! Ich! Vom Umgang mit Narzissmus
programme.desc: Talkshow zu Themen wie Familienprobleme, Schicksalsschläge und Alltagsbewältigung.

programme.title: NDR Talk Show
programme.desc: Alle zwei Wochen werden interessante Gäste zu einer Talkrunde nach Hamburg eingeladen.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft
programme.desc: In der Sachsenklinik steht Dr. Ina Schulte ein medizinisches Wunder bevor: Sie soll die Zwillinge von Hilda Renner, die an der Leber zusammengewachsen sind, per Kaiserschnitt entbinden. Doch die werdende Mutter befindet sich in einem Ausnahmezustand.

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft - Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Nina Iacob bringt ihren eigenwilligen Vater Erwin, der eine Sprunggelenksverletzung erlitten hat, ins Klinikum. Während Matteo Moreau ihn behandelt, treten Konflikte zutage, weil Nina den Hof in Rumänien aufgegeben hat, um in Erfurt zu leben.

programme.title: Tierärztin Dr. Mertens
programme.desc: In der Nähe der tschechischen Grenze taucht ein Braunbär auf, der sich aus Böhmen hierher verirrt hat. Der sächsische Staatssekretär Bredow bittet Dr. Fährmann um Hilfe. Daraufhin will dieser zusammen mit Susanne, Georg Baumgart und Nicole Sommer den Bären einfangen und nach Böhmen zurückbringen. Doch der Bär ist auffallend aggressiv, so dass Bredow ihn zum Abschuss freigibt.

programme.title: Kochs anders - Gourmetideen aus Hessen
programme.sub-title: Ali, die Designerin und die Cannelloni
programme.desc: Da staunt Ali, der Profikoch aus München, nicht schlecht, in ihrer bunten Wohnung in einem ehemaligen Fabrikgebäude in Offenbach zaubert die Kinderbuch-Illustratorin Manuela Olten ebenso farbenfrohe wie ungewöhnlich gefüllte Ravioli.

programme.title: Kochstories
programme.desc: In der Sendung werden Geschichten von Menschen gezeigt, die kulinarisch etwas zu bieten haben.

programme.title: Mit Herz am Herd
programme.desc: Sternekoch Cliff Hämmerle zeigt vier Kochschülern leckere Gerichte. Damit es am Ende auch was Feines zum Essen gibt, führt er seine Schüler zielsicher ans Rezept heran. Cliff's Rezepte sind einfach und gut und seine Produkte sind regional.

programme.title: Meisterküche
programme.desc: Die Konditormeisterin Theresa Knipschild stellt ein schnelles Orangen-Dessert vor und backt gemeinsam mit der Moderatorin einen Apfelkuchen. Die Köchin Zora Klipp schiebt eine Blätterteigpizza mit mediterranem Gemüse in den Ofen.

programme.title: Gartenzeit
programme.desc: Gartenzeit ist das Magazin für Gartenfreunde in Berlin und Brandenburg. Die serviceorientierte Sendung gibt viele praktische Tipps und Hinweise, holt Auskünfte von Profi-Gärtnern ein und stellt Hobbygärtner und ihre wundervollen Gärten vor.

Expedition Unknown – Mythen auf der Spur
programme.desc: Infos zur Reihe:\n\nIn "Expedition Unknown" begibt sich Josh Gates auf die Spur historischer Mythen, die bis heute Fragen aufwerfen: Von den Pyramiden der Maya über die Seereisen der Wikinger bis zu den legendären Steinkreisen von Stonehenge. Die Serie untersucht fesselnde Geschichtsrätsel und versucht, die Geheimnisse hinter den Ruinen von El Mirador in Guatemala zu entschlüsseln, die von Bäumen und Schlingpflanzen überwuchert sind. Ebenso werden die mutmaßlichen Reisen der nordischen Seefahrer über den Atlantik nach Amerika und die Funktion der Megalith-Monumente nahe der englischen Stadt Salisbury untersucht. Dabei werden spannende Fakten präsentiert und die Meinungen der Experten diskutiert, die oft unterschiedlich sind.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: Nun hat Sean Boswell (Lucas Black) ziemlichen Ärger am Hals: Seine Karre zu Schrott gefahren plus Anzeige wegen Körperverletzung. Ihm droht ein Knastaufenthalt, weshalb ihn seine Mom ins Exil schickt – zu Papi nach Tokio. Der ermahnt den Flegel pflichtschuldigst. Bald macht Sean auch Japans Straßen unsicher. Dummerweise tritt er dabei einem Yakuza-Mitglied auf die Füße und verguckt sich in eine Gangsterbraut. \n\nViele Rennszenen wurden in Los Angeles gedreht, die Straßen asiatisch „verkleidet“. Der echte „Drift-King“ Keiichi Tsuchiya hat eine Minirolle als Fischer, Reihenheld Vin Diesel nur eine Gastrolle.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc:
„Das Wichtigste ist die Familie!“ Das sieht nicht nur der Profiraser Dom (Diesel) so, sondern auch der Londoner Gangster Deckard Shaw (Jason Statham). Dessen gemeingefährlichen Bruder Owen hatten Dom, Schwager Brian (Walker) & Co. in Teil sechs aus dem Verkehr gezogen. Als Deckard einen Rachefeldzug startet, bekommen die Freunde Unterstützung von Bulle Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson), CIA-Großvater Mr. Nobody (Kurt Russell) und dem geheimnisvollen Hacker Ramsey…

Als Walker 2013 abseits des Sets bei einem Crash ums Leben kam, waren viele seiner Szenen noch nicht abgedreht. Also sprangen seine Brüder Caleb und Cody ein, die dank Computertrick mit Pauls Gesicht agierten. Ein würdiger Abschied: Der zweistündige, fast surreale Vehikelwahnsinn ist der bislang erfolgreichste Teil der Reihe (Einspielergebnis: gut 1,5 Milliarden Dollar!). 

Ob Hochhausspringen in Abu Dhabi mit einem 750 PS starken Lykan Hypersport, Crashorgien im Kaukasus oder Kriegszustände an der US-Westküste: In seinem stylishen Inferno zelebriert James Wan („Saw“) die testosterongesteuerte Zerstörungswut im überhöhten Comicstil. Besser hätte Marvel die Drohnenangriffe in L. A. oder den Kampf der Titanen zwischen Dwayne Johnson und Jason Statham auch nicht hingekriegt. 

Doch bei aller Action: Am Ende hält der Film inne und verabschiedet sich mit den Worten Vin Diesels von Paul Walker in markig-emotionaler „Fast & Furious“-Manier: „Wir gehen unser Leben in Vier-Meilen-Schritten. Darum sind wir Brüder.“.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc:
Eigentlich wollte der rehabilitierte PS-Ganove Dom Toretto (Vin Diesel) auf Kuba mit seiner Letty (Michelle Rodriguez) flittern – „die Menschen, die Kultur, die Schönheit“ genießen und ab und zu mit „kubanischem Nitro“ unter der Haube durch Havanna brettern. Sorry, Bro, daraus wird nichts. Die durchgeknallte Hackerin Cipher (Charlize Theron) hält Doms Ex-Frau und seinen Sohn gefangen und zwingt Dom, für sie zu arbeiten – gegen seine alte Clique! 

Doch weil Familie bekanntlich über alles geht, schickt selbige sich an, ihn gemeinsam mit alten Bekannten wie Muskelprotz Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson) und Geheimagent Petty (Kurt Russell), aber auch mit der Unterstützung von Vorgängerschurke Deckard Shaw (Jason Statham) zurückzuholen… 

„Straight Outta Compton“-Regisseur F. Gary Gray hat einen unterhaltsamen Blockbuster voller übergeschnappter All-Star-Action inszeniert – und der kam an: Mit einem weltweiten Einspielergebnis von mehr als 1,2 Milliarden Dollar wird „Fast & Furious 8“ bisher nur von seinem Vorgänger Teil 7 (rund 1,5 Milliarden Dollar) getoppt. 

Der erste Film der Reihe ohne den 2013 verstorbenen Co-Star Paul Walker schmückt sich mit hochwillkommener Selbstironie. Wenn die mal fehlt, wird’s auch gleich etwas triefig. Aber kein Problem: Das ist dann die Gelegenheit, ein neues Bier vom Balkon zu holen!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc:
Leiden können sich Secret-Service-Agent Luke Hobbs (Johnson) und Ex-Elitesoldat Deckard Shaw (Statham) noch immer nicht, doch für die Rettung des Planeten raufen sich die zwei Kamikaze-Vögel schließlich doch zusammen: Der ehemalige MI6-Agent Brixton Lore (Idris Elba) hat sich der Terror-Organisation Eteon angeschlossen und wurde von ihr zu einem nahezu unverwundbaren Mensch-Maschinen-Hybrid umprogrammiert. 

Er jagt einem tödlichen Virus hinterher, das sich ausgerechnet Shaws Schwester Hattie (Vanessa Kirby) injiziert hat. Sie hat nur 72 Stunden Zeit, um die Kapseln wieder aus ihrem Körper zu entfernen, sonst lösen sich ihre Organe in Flüssigkeit auf… 

Dass die Chemie zwischen ihnen stimmt, bewiesen Dwayne „The Rock“ Johnson („Jumanji“) und Jason Statham („Meg“) bereits 2017 in „Fast & Furious 8“. Die erste eigene Mission des Testosterongespanns ohne Vin Diesel und die anderen Crash-Junkies spielte weltweit 759 Millionen Dollar ein und ist ein riesiges Action-Spektakel, bei dem die flotten Karren jedoch nur am Rande eine Rolle spielen. 

Die Hauptattraktion des Films von Regisseur David Leitch („John Wick“, „Atomic Blonde“, „Deadpool 2“) ist das amüsante Geplänkel zwischen den beiden Stars, die den wilden Stunts ein wenig die Show stehlen. Und wie es sich für das Franchise gehört, wird eine Ode auf die Familie gesungen.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 9
programme.desc:
Eigentlich möchte Streetracer Dom vom nervenaufreibenden Leben zwischen Verfolgungsjagden, Explosionen und Kugelhagel nichts mehr wissen. Gemeinsam mit Letty und Sohn Brian hat er sich aufs Land zurückgezogen. Als sein altes Team mit einer neuen Mission vor der Tür steht, lehnt er ab. 

Als Letty jedoch zusagt und Dom einen Hinweis auf seinen verschollenen Bruder Jakob entdeckt, schließt auch er sich der neuen Mission an. Ihr Ziel: verhindern, dass Jakob, dessen Boss und Hackerin Cipher an den zweiten Teil eines Geräts kommen, mit dem man internetbasierte Systeme weltweit kontrollieren kann… 

Mit gewohnt viel Wumms, PS und Sinn für Familie rauschen Dom und seine Crew in ihr neuntes Abenteuer. Dass die Handlung und die Stunts komplett hanebüchen sind und die Charaktere allzu wankelmütig, wird Fans der Reihe wohl kaum stören. 

Highlights – auch für Nicht-Fans: der ultracoole, leider viel zu kurze dritte Auftritt von Helen Mirren im „F&F“-Universum und die amüsanten Metasprüche von Roman, der kurz davorsteht zu erkennen, dass er eine Filmfigur ist.

programme.title: Can You Ever Forgive Me?
programme.desc:
Nach ihrem Erfolg als Biografin von Promis ist die New Yorkerin Lee Israel (Melissa McCarthy) am beruflichen Tiefpunkt angelangt. Denn ihre Biografien sind nicht mehr gefragt. Auch bei ihrer Agentin kann Lee mit neuen Ideen nicht punkten. Unbezahlte Rechnungen und ihre kranke Katze bringen die Autorin dazu, dem Glück nachzuhelfen. Beim Verkauf einer schriftlichen Nachricht, die sie einst von Katharine Hepburn erhalten hatte, erfährt Lee, dass es eine florierende Sammlerszene gibt. 

Nachdem sie einen Brief der Komikerin Fanny Brice aus der Bibliothek gestohlen und verkauft hat, baut sich Lee gemeinsam mit ihrem Saufkumpanen Jack (Richard E. Grant) ein raffiniertes Fälschersystem auf, bei dem sie Briefe von Marlene Dietrich, Dorothy Parker und anderen Berühmtheiten fälscht und an Sammler verkauft. Doch bald werden die Behörden auf Lee und ihre Briefe aufmerksam… 

Mehr als 400 Briefe stahl, fälschte und verkaufte Lee Israel laut eigener Aussage bis zu ihrer Verhaftung und ihrem Schuldbekenntnis 1993. Die Memoiren der 2014 verstorbenen Autorin bilden die Grundlage dieser spitzzüngigen Tragikomödie von Marielle Heller („The Diary of a Teenage Girl“), in der die sonst so schrille Melissa McCarthy mit einer zurückhaltenden und mit schwarzem Humor gespickten Performance überrascht.

programme.title: Lejeune
programme.desc: Johanna Nagel stellt Ihnen engagierte Landfrauen aus dem bayerischen Bauernverband vor, die großartige Gerichte mit uns kochen: von herzhaft bis süß, von traditionell bis originell, hier gibt es Ideen, Tipps und Rezepte rund ums bayerische Essen. Diese Landfrauen kommen aus unterschiedlichen landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben in ganz Bayern und lieben die Landwirtschaft und lieben Bayern! Hier erfahren Sie viel über die Vielfalt und Qualität der heimischen Erzeugnisse, aber auch die Arbeit und das Engagement der Landwirte.Moderatorin Johanna Nagel führt uns in die kulinarische Welt der bayerischen Landfrauen und trifft auf Landfrau Evi Rieger und Expertin Lea Miesl. Gekocht wird ein Apfelkuchen mit Vanillesoße. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Record 089
programme.desc: In der 45-minütigen Sendung trifft Alexander Onken Musikerinnen und Musiker zum Dialog in einer angesagten Location. Pro Ausgabe können das nacheinander mehrere Gäste sein – oder auch mal nur einer. In jedem Fall sind es spannende Newcomer oder bereits etablierte Künstler.Um eine intime Atmosphäre zu schaffen, verzichten wir ganz bewusst auf ein großes Setting (viele Scheinwerfer, viele Kameras, viel Technik). In der Postproduktion wird das Gespräch mit dem jeweiligen Musikvideo vereint, lockert so den Talk auf, treibt das Thema voran und hält gleichzeitig die Stimmung des Songs. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: München tut gut
programme.desc: München tut gut soll ein positives Lebensgefühl erzeugen und ist eine wöchentliche Sendung mit Reportage-Elementen. Das Format soll aufklären, inspirieren und die positiven Seiten des Lebens in den Mittelpunkt rücken. München tut gut berichtet über alltagsnahe Themen und aktuelle Trends mit Wohlfühlcharakter. Ziel des Formats ist es, den Zuschauern einen Impuls und vor allem einen Nutzen zu vermitteln. Es kann so einfach sein, sich selbst und anderen etwas Gutes zu tun. Manchmal fehlt nur ein ganz kleiner Impuls und genau den möchten wir jede Woche wieder aufs Neue finden. (Senderinfo).

Infos zur Serie:

Schere, Stein und Papier teilen sich eine Wohnung – für beste Freunde doch selbstverständlich. Aber im Alltag ist das Zusammenleben dann doch nicht immer so einfach und so versinkt die WG regelmäßig im Chaos.

Und dann gibt’s noch Papier – das kreative Genie, das mit seinen cleveren Erfindungen (fast) immer eine Lösung parat hat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: When You Wish Upon A Star
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

Plus, Dr. Phil correspondent and comedienne Kathleen Madigan finds out what people on the streets are vowing to never do again in 2010. Everyone is in stitches during this lighthearted look at New Year’s resolutions. Don’t miss this show!

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

programme.desc: En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El veintiuno (21) de abril de dos mil once (2011) en Caicedonia (Valle) ocurre el atroz asesinato de Jenifer Hoyos una niña de nueve (9) años a manos de Yeison Leandro Ortiz un amigo de la familia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Sandra seduce y manipula a su joven amante Gyan Carlos, convenciéndolo de asesinar a su esposo Mauricio a cambio de amor y una vida juntos. Sin saberlo, Gyan Carlos no era el único hombre bajo su control. Tras el crimen, errores de novatos facilitaron la investigación, llevando tanto a Sandra como a su amante a pagar una larga condena en prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.sub-title: Quarterfinal - Utah Valley University vs. Indiana University
programme.desc: The atmosphere is electric as the top-seeded Indiana Hoosiers clash with the relentless Utah Valley Wolverines in a high-stakes quarterfinal showdown. With a boisterous Hoosier crowd fueling every point, UVU’s powerhouse duo must find a way to silence the stands and keep their hunt for a first national title alive. Witness explosive "howitzer" drives and tactical brilliance as these elite programs trade blows in a must-win battle for a spot in the Final Four.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: Back to Back

Get ready to be swept away in a whirlwind of adrenaline-pumping quests, where danger and discovery await them at every turn.

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Sprinter Galore
programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Ryan Defrates

programme.title: Ancient Bible Destinations of Greece
programme.sub-title: Ancient Bible Destinations of Greece S01E02
programme.desc: Ancient Bible Destinations of Greece takes a spiritual journey throughout the country, breathing life into the history of the early days of Christianity and offering relevant and powerful insights to the events told in the world's bestselling book—the Bible. Narrated by Sir David Suchet and featuring Ancient Greek historian Dr. Michael Scott, the series uncovers in intimate detail the destinations that provided the backdrop for the amazing lives of some of the most well-known Christians. Ancient Bible Destinations visits some of Greece’s most popular cities, ruins, and historical sites in destinations including Athens, Thessaloniki, Ancient Phillipi, Kavala, Ancient Corinth, Ancient Olympia, and many more.

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: In UNESCO‑listed Cuenca, Karen LeBlanc discovers traditions alive: Panama hat weaving, copper rosesmiths, guitar makers, black ceramics, silver filigree, and healing teas. Ride the Inca Trail and sip craft culture in this vibrant Ecuadorian city.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.
